method: Each section read in full by a machine-assisted reviewer against the packs and the ground catalogue as of this date; not a legal review.

sections.bearsOn: Defines disposition broadly (any grant of, or permission to use, Crown land, minerals, timber or water), ecology, ecosystem and habitat; the breadth of "disposition" is what makes s. 5 bar a cutting or road permit.
The purpose of ecological reserves: research and education, representative and recovering ecosystems, rare species and unique phenomena.
Cabinet establishes, enlarges or reduces ecological reserves on Crown land; those in Protected Areas Act Schedules A and B change only by statute.
Orders establishing or modifying reserves must be published in the Gazette.

An ecological reserve is withdrawn and reserved from any further disposition under any Act, the Forest Act, Land Act, Range Act, Mineral Tenure Act and Water Sustainability Act among them, except a s. 5.1 research permit; no cutting permit, road permit or grazing tenure can be granted in one.
The minister may permit use and occupation of a reserve only for ecological research or education, on terms protecting it.
A designated wildland area may be made an ecological reserve despite the Park Act.
The minister may designate directors and delegate penalty powers.
Administrative penalties for contravening the regulations or a permit.
Appeals of administrative penalties to the Environmental Appeal Board.
Regulations controlling use of reserves and other ministers' powers in them, permits and offences.
Offences against the regulations: fines up to $200 000 a day.
The minister may appoint advisers on reserves.
The Act and its regulations apply to every reserve despite any other Act.
